tools.name: get_market_data
tools.description: Get dated aggregate asking prices, model-year recalls, and EPA fuel economy. Results include data freshness; unavailable values are null and unavailable lists are empty. Does not return listings or a vehicle appraisal.

tools.name: check_recalls
tools.description: Read available NHTSA model-year recall campaigns and complaint counts. These records do not establish a specific VIN's recall coverage or repair status.

tools.name: decode_vin
tools.description: Decode available vehicle specifications from a VIN. This lookup does not provide accident history or recall repair status.

tools.name: create_scout
tools.description: Create a saved search (scout) from vehicle and filter criteria or a VIN pattern. Each request carries a creationRequestId from check_limits, so a matching retry returns the existing scout instead of a duplicate. Scouts check roughly every 24 hours and email a daily digest of new matches and price dr

tools.name: list_scouts
tools.description: Read your saved scouts, full search criteria, status, and latest update time. Scout names are text the user entered.

tools.name: get_scout
tools.description: Read one of your scouts, including every search criterion and its latest update time.

tools.name: update_scout
tools.description: Change the supplied fields of one scout and keep the rest. This overwrites the supplied saved criteria and changes future marketplace checks and daily digests. vehicleIndex edits one saved vehicle, and vehicleCombinations replaces the full vehicle list. Filter objects change only the supplied includ

tools.name: delete_scout
tools.description: Delete one scout. This stops its daily checks and deletes its saved alerts.

tools.name: check_limits
tools.description: Return your scout capacity and a creationRequestId with requestExpiresAt. create_scout accepts the ID for 24 hours, and a matching retry returns the existing scout instead of a duplicate.

tools.name: get_alerts
tools.description: Read saved matches from one of your scouts, one page at a time. This does not run a new inventory search. Dealer names, titles, and links are third-party listing data.

tools.name: dismiss_alert
tools.description: Dismiss one saved match from one of your scouts, with a reason.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Send a bug report, feature request, or feedback to the CarScout team. This saves the report and can send an email notification to CarScout support that cannot be recalled.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_scout · Private data: check_recalls · Public sink: create_scout, submit_feedback · Destructive: delete_scout, get_alerts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_scout · Private data: check_recalls · Public sink: create_scout, submit_feedback · Destructive: delete_scout, get_alerts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
